headline: Keep the plan, proof, and next step together.
lede: LifeThread turns an open-ended goal into an adaptive plan without losing the evidence or decisions behind it.
demoLabel: Recorded AI fixture · local private demo
goalPlaceholder: Describe any goal in Korean, English, or both
createHeadline: Turn one open goal into a living, cited plan.
createLede: No template or category is required. The recorded local adapter proposes a tentative plan that remains under your control.
dashboardLede: Keep each goal in its own thread so the next action, evidence, and decisions stay together.
dashboardEmptyBody: Start with one goal. You can keep several plans moving without mixing their evidence or decisions.
dashboardCreateBody: Describe the outcome in your own words. We will open a dedicated thread for it.
dashboardCreatePlaceholder: Describe a goal in Korean, English, or both
evidencePlaceholder: Add an original note; it remains private and verbatim
limitationsText: Single demo profile. Recorded AI fixture. No public sharing, production authentication, file delivery, or external sending.
actionError: LifeThread could not apply that request. Your workspace is unchanged.

whatDoYouWantDone: What are you trying to get done?
goalIntro: Describe the outcome in your own words. LifeThread will suggest a small plan you can change at any time.
